en.text: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

zhSimplified.text: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的，

zhTraditional.text: 行為完全、遵行耶和華律法的，

en.text: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

zhSimplified.text: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的，

zhTraditional.text: 遵守他的法度、一心尋求他的，

en.text: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 这人不做非义的事，

zhTraditional.text: 這人不做非義的事，

en.text: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你曾將你的訓詞吩咐我們，

en.text: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

zhSimplified.text: 但愿我行事坚定，

zhTraditional.text: 但願我行事堅定，

en.text: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 我看重你的一切命令，

zhTraditional.text: 我看重你的一切命令，

en.text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, learn your righteous judgments.

zhSimplified.text: 我学了你公义的判语，

zhTraditional.text: 我學了你公義的判語，

en.text: I will observe your statutes. utterly forsake me.

zhSimplified.text: 我必守你的律例；

zhTraditional.text: 我必守你的律例；

en.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 少年人用什么洁净他的行为呢？

zhTraditional.text: 少年人用甚麼潔淨他的行為呢？

en.text: With my whole heart I have sought you. me wander from your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 我一心寻求了你；

zhTraditional.text: 我一心尋求了你；

en.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

zhSimplified.text: 我将你的话藏在心里，

zhTraditional.text: 我將你的話藏在心裏，

en.text: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你是應當稱頌的！

en.text: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。

zhTraditional.text: 我用嘴唇傳揚你口中的一切典章。

en.text: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

zhSimplified.text: 我喜悦你的法度，

zhTraditional.text: 我喜悅你的法度，

en.text: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 我要默想你的训词，

zhTraditional.text: 我要默想你的訓詞，

en.text: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我要在你的律例中自乐；

zhTraditional.text: 我要在你的律例中自樂；

en.text: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

zhSimplified.text: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活，

zhTraditional.text: 求你用厚恩待你的僕人，使我存活，

en.text: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

zhSimplified.text: 求你开我的眼睛，

zhTraditional.text: 求你開我的眼睛，

en.text: I am a stranger on the earth. hide your commandments from me.

zhSimplified.text: 我是在地上作寄居的；

zhTraditional.text: 我是在地上作寄居的；

en.text: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

zhSimplified.text: 我时常切慕你的典章，

zhTraditional.text: 我時常切慕你的典章，

en.text: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, wander from your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人，

zhTraditional.text: 受咒詛、偏離你命令的驕傲人，

en.text: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视，

zhTraditional.text: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐視，

en.text: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 虽有首领坐着妄论我，

zhTraditional.text: 雖有首領坐着妄論我，

en.text: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.

zhSimplified.text: 你的法度是我所喜乐的，

zhTraditional.text: 你的法度是我所喜樂的，

en.text: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

zhSimplified.text: 我的性命几乎归于尘土；

zhTraditional.text: 我的性命幾乎歸於塵土；

en.text: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我；

zhTraditional.text: 我述說我所行的，你應允了我；

en.text: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! I will meditate on your wondrous works.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我明白你的训词，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我明白你的訓詞，

en.text: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心因愁苦而消化；

zhTraditional.text: 我的心因愁苦而消化；

en.text: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我离开奸诈的道，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我離開奸詐的道，

en.text: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

zhSimplified.text: 我拣选了忠信的道， 。

zhTraditional.text: 我揀選了忠信的道， 。

en.text: I cling to your statutes, LORD. be disappointed.

zhSimplified.text: 我持守你的法度；

zhTraditional.text: 我持守你的法度；

en.text: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

zhSimplified.text: 你开广我心的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 你開廣我心的時候，

en.text: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你將你的律例指教我，

en.text: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. I will obey it with my whole heart.

zhSimplified.text: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 求你賜我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，

en.text: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

zhSimplified.text: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，

zhTraditional.text: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，

en.text: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我的心趨向你的法度，

en.text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假，

zhTraditional.text: 求你叫我轉眼不看虛假，

en.text: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

zhSimplified.text: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话，

zhTraditional.text: 你向敬畏你的人所應許的話，

en.text: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我所怕的羞辱遠離我，

en.text: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 我羡慕你的训词；

zhTraditional.text: 我羨慕你的訓詞；

en.text: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，願你照你的話，使你的慈愛，

en.text: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的，

zhTraditional.text: 我就有話回答那羞辱我的，

en.text: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口，

zhTraditional.text: 求你叫真理的話總不離開我口，

en.text: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 我要常守你的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 我要常守你的律法，

en.text: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 我要自由而行，

footnotes.text: - 119:45 或译：我要行在宽阔之地

zhTraditional.text: 我要自由而行，

footnotes.text: - 119:45 或譯：我要行在寬闊之地

en.text: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

zhSimplified.text: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度，

zhTraditional.text: 我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，

en.text: I will delight myself in your commandments,

zhSimplified.text: 我要在你的命令中自乐；

zhTraditional.text: 我要在你的命令中自樂；

en.text: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我又要遵行你的命令，

zhTraditional.text: 我又要遵行你的命令，

en.text: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

zhSimplified.text: 求你记念向你仆人的话，

zhTraditional.text: 求你記念向你僕人的話，

en.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

zhSimplified.text: 这话将我救活了；

zhTraditional.text: 這話將我救活了；

en.text: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我，

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲的人甚侮慢我，

en.text: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我記念你從古以來的典章，

en.text: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

zhSimplified.text: 我见恶人离弃你的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 我見惡人離棄你的律法，

en.text: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

zhSimplified.text: 我在世寄居，

zhTraditional.text: 我在世寄居，

en.text: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，

en.text: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 我所以如此，

zhTraditional.text: 我所以如此，

en.text: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是我的福分；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是我的福分；

en.text: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我一心求过你的恩；

zhTraditional.text: 我一心求過你的恩；

en.text: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我思想我所行的道，

zhTraditional.text: 我思想我所行的道，

en.text: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 我急忙遵守你的命令，

zhTraditional.text: 我急忙遵守你的命令，

en.text: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的绳索缠绕我，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的繩索纏繞我，

en.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 我因你公义的典章，

zhTraditional.text: 我因你公義的典章，

en.text: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，

zhTraditional.text: 凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，

en.text: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；

en.text: You have treated your servant well, to your word, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。

en.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 求你将精明和知识赐给我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你將精明和知識賜給我，

en.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，

zhTraditional.text: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，

en.text: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 你本为善，所行的也善；

zhTraditional.text: 你本為善，所行的也善；

en.text: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我，

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲人編造謊言攻擊我，

en.text: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

zhSimplified.text: 他们心蒙脂油，

zhTraditional.text: 他們心蒙脂油，

en.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我受苦是与我有益，

zhTraditional.text: 我受苦是與我有益，

en.text: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

zhSimplified.text: 你口中的训言与我有益，

zhTraditional.text: 你口中的訓言與我有益，

en.text: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 你的手制造我，建立我；

zhTraditional.text: 你的手製造我，建立我；

en.text: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜，

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏你的人見我就要歡喜，

en.text: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的；

en.text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, to your word to your servant.

zhSimplified.text: 求你照着仆人的话，

zhTraditional.text: 求你照着僕人的話，

en.text: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活，

zhTraditional.text: 願你的慈悲臨到我，使我存活，

en.text: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我；

zhTraditional.text: 願驕傲人蒙羞，因為他們無理地傾覆我；

en.text: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 愿敬畏你的人归向我，

zhTraditional.text: 願敬畏你的人歸向我，

en.text: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全，

zhTraditional.text: 願我的心在你的律例上完全，

en.text: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我心渴想你的救恩，

zhTraditional.text: 我心渴想你的救恩，

en.text: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

zhSimplified.text: 我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，说：

zhTraditional.text: 我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，說：

en.text: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我好像烟薰的皮袋，

zhTraditional.text: 我好像煙薰的皮袋，

en.text: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

zhSimplified.text: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你僕人的年日有多少呢？

en.text: The proud have dug pits for me, to your law.

zhSimplified.text: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。

zhTraditional.text: 不從你律法的驕傲人為我掘了坑。

en.text: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

zhSimplified.text: 你的命令尽都诚实；

zhTraditional.text: 你的命令盡都誠實；

en.text: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝，

zhTraditional.text: 他們幾乎把我從世上滅絕，

en.text: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活，

zhTraditional.text: 求你照你的慈愛將我救活，

en.text: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的話安定在天，

en.text: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

zhSimplified.text: 你的诚实存到万代；

zhTraditional.text: 你的誠實存到萬代；

en.text: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

zhSimplified.text: 天地照你的安排存到今日；

zhTraditional.text: 天地照你的安排存到今日；

en.text: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

zhSimplified.text: 我若不是喜爱你的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 我若不是喜愛你的律法，

en.text: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

zhSimplified.text: 我永不忘记你的训词，

zhTraditional.text: 我永不忘記你的訓詞，

en.text: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 我是属你的，求你救我，

zhTraditional.text: 我是屬你的，求你救我，

en.text: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. will consider your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人等待我，要滅絕我，

en.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.

zhSimplified.text: 我看万事尽都有限，

zhTraditional.text: 我看萬事盡都有限，

en.text: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

zhSimplified.text: 我何等爱慕你的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 我何等愛慕你的律法，

en.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

zhSimplified.text: 你的命令常存在我心里，

zhTraditional.text: 你的命令常存在我心裏，

en.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

zhSimplified.text: 我比我的师傅更通达，

zhTraditional.text: 我比我的師傅更通達，

en.text: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 我比年老的更明白，

zhTraditional.text: 我比年老的更明白，

en.text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路，

zhTraditional.text: 我禁止我腳走一切的邪路，

en.text: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

zhSimplified.text: 我没有偏离你的典章，

zhTraditional.text: 我沒有偏離你的典章，

en.text: How sweet are your promises to my taste, honey to my mouth!

zhSimplified.text: 你的言语在我上膛何等甘美，

zhTraditional.text: 你的言語在我上膛何等甘美，

en.text: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

zhSimplified.text: 我借着你的训词得以明白，

zhTraditional.text: 我藉着你的訓詞得以明白，

en.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

zhSimplified.text: 你的话是我脚前的灯，

zhTraditional.text: 你的話是我腳前的燈，

en.text: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守，

zhTraditional.text: 你公義的典章，我曾起誓遵守，

en.text: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我甚是受苦；

zhTraditional.text: 我甚是受苦；

en.text: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你悅納我口中的讚美為供物，

en.text: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

zhSimplified.text: 我的性命常在危险之中，

zhTraditional.text: 我的性命常在危險之中，

en.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人为我设下网罗，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人為我設下網羅，

en.text: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

zhSimplified.text: 我以你的法度为永远的产业，

zhTraditional.text: 我以你的法度為永遠的產業，

en.text: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心专向你的律例，

zhTraditional.text: 我的心專向你的律例，

en.text: I hate double-minded men, your law.

zhSimplified.text: 心怀二意的人为我所恨；

zhTraditional.text: 心懷二意的人為我所恨；

en.text: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

zhSimplified.text: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌；

zhTraditional.text: 你是我藏身之處，又是我的盾牌；

en.text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

zhSimplified.text: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我吧！

zhTraditional.text: 作惡的人哪，你們離開我吧！

en.text: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. me not be ashamed of my hope.

zhSimplified.text: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活，

zhTraditional.text: 求你照你的話扶持我，使我存活，

en.text: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

zhSimplified.text: 求你扶持我，我便得救，

zhTraditional.text: 求你扶持我，我便得救，

en.text: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

zhSimplified.text: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们，

zhTraditional.text: 凡偏離你律例的人，你都輕棄他們，

en.text: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

zhSimplified.text: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；

zhTraditional.text: 凡地上的惡人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；

en.text: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

zhSimplified.text: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖；

zhTraditional.text: 我因懼怕你，肉就發抖；

en.text: I have done what is just and righteous. leave me to my oppressors.

zhSimplified.text: 我行过公平和公义，

zhTraditional.text: 我行過公平和公義，

en.text: Ensure your servant’s well-being. the proud oppress me.

zhSimplified.text: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处，

zhTraditional.text: 求你為僕人作保，使我得好處，

en.text: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

zhSimplified.text: 我因盼望你的救恩

zhTraditional.text: 我因盼望你的救恩

en.text: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人，

zhTraditional.text: 求你照你的慈愛待僕人，

en.text: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

zhSimplified.text: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性，

zhTraditional.text: 我是你的僕人，求你賜我悟性，

en.text: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

zhSimplified.text: 这是耶和华降罚的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 這是耶和華降罰的時候，

en.text: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子，

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我愛你的命令勝於金子，

en.text: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

zhSimplified.text: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直；

zhTraditional.text: 你一切的訓詞，在萬事上我都以為正直；

en.text: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

zhSimplified.text: 你的法度奇妙，

zhTraditional.text: 你的法度奇妙，

en.text: The entrance of your words gives light. to the simple.

zhSimplified.text: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光，

zhTraditional.text: 你的言語一解開就發出亮光，

en.text: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 我张口而气喘，

zhTraditional.text: 我張口而氣喘，

en.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

zhSimplified.text: 求你转向我，怜悯我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你轉向我，憐憫我，

en.text: Establish my footsteps in your word. let any iniquity have dominion over me.

zhSimplified.text: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当，

zhTraditional.text: 求你用你的話使我腳步穩當，

en.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, I will observe your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 求你救我脱离人的欺压，

zhTraditional.text: 求你救我脫離人的欺壓，

en.text: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 求你用脸光照仆人，

zhTraditional.text: 求你用臉光照僕人，

en.text: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.

zhSimplified.text: 我的眼泪下流成河，

zhTraditional.text: 我的眼淚下流成河，

en.text: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你是公义的；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你是公義的；

en.text: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. are fully trustworthy.

zhSimplified.text: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。

zhTraditional.text: 你所命定的法度是憑公義和至誠。

en.text: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

zhSimplified.text: 我心焦急，如同火烧，

zhTraditional.text: 我心焦急，如同火燒，

en.text: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

zhSimplified.text: 你的话极其精炼，

zhTraditional.text: 你的話極其精煉，

en.text: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 我微小，被人藐视，

zhTraditional.text: 我微小，被人藐視，

en.text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

zhSimplified.text: 你的公义永远长存；

zhTraditional.text: 你的公義永遠長存；

en.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

zhSimplified.text: 我遭遇患难愁苦，

zhTraditional.text: 我遭遇患難愁苦，

en.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

zhSimplified.text: 你的法度永远是公义的；

zhTraditional.text: 你的法度永遠是公義的；

en.text: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我一心呼籲你；

en.text: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！

zhTraditional.text: 我向你呼籲，求你救我！

en.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

zhSimplified.text: 我趁天未亮呼求；

zhTraditional.text: 我趁天未亮呼求；

en.text: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开，

zhTraditional.text: 我趁夜更未換將眼睜開，

en.text: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音；

zhTraditional.text: 求你照你的慈愛聽我的聲音；

en.text: They draw near who follow after wickedness. are far from your law.

zhSimplified.text: 追求奸恶的人临近了；

zhTraditional.text: 追求奸惡的人臨近了；

en.text: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你与我相近；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你與我相近；

en.text: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.

zhSimplified.text: 我因你的法度，

zhTraditional.text: 我因你的法度，

en.text: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

zhSimplified.text: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你看顧我的苦難，搭救我，

en.text: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

zhSimplified.text: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我，

zhTraditional.text: 求你為我辨屈，救贖我，

en.text: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 救恩远离恶人，

zhTraditional.text: 救恩遠離惡人，

en.text: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的慈悲本為大；

en.text: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

zhSimplified.text: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多，

zhTraditional.text: 逼迫我的，抵擋我的，很多，

en.text: I look at the faithless with loathing, they don’t observe your word.

zhSimplified.text: 我看见奸恶的人就甚憎恶，

zhTraditional.text: 我看見奸惡的人就甚憎惡，

en.text: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

zhSimplified.text: 你看我怎样爱你的训词！

zhTraditional.text: 你看我怎樣愛你的訓詞！

en.text: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. AND SHIN

zhSimplified.text: 你话的总纲是真实；

zhTraditional.text: 你話的總綱是真實；

en.text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

zhSimplified.text: 首领无故地逼迫我，

zhTraditional.text: 首領無故地逼迫我，

en.text: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

zhSimplified.text: 我喜爱你的话，

zhTraditional.text: 我喜愛你的話，

en.text: I hate and abhor falsehood. your law.

zhSimplified.text: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的；

zhTraditional.text: 謊話是我所恨惡所憎嫌的；

en.text: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

zhSimplified.text: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。

zhTraditional.text: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。

en.text: Those who love your law have great peace. to stumble.

zhSimplified.text: 爱你律法的人有大平安，

zhTraditional.text: 愛你律法的人有大平安，

en.text: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我仰望了你的救恩，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我仰望了你的救恩，

en.text: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

zhSimplified.text: 我心里守了你的法度；

zhTraditional.text: 我心裏守了你的法度；

en.text: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.

zhSimplified.text: 我遵守了你的训词和法度，

zhTraditional.text: 我遵守了你的訓詞和法度，

en.text: Let my cry come before you, LORD. me understanding according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，愿我的呼吁达到你面前，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，願我的呼籲達到你面前，

en.text: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的恳求达到你面前，

zhTraditional.text: 願我的懇求達到你面前，

en.text: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话，

zhTraditional.text: 願我的嘴發出讚美的話，

en.text: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话，

zhTraditional.text: 願我的舌頭歌唱你的話，

en.text: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你用手帮助我，

zhTraditional.text: 願你用手幫助我，

en.text: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我切慕你的救恩！

en.text: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！

zhTraditional.text: 願我的性命存活，得以讚美你！

en.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

zhSimplified.text: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人，

zhTraditional.text: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你尋找僕人，
